description: Guiyang Traffic Flow Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors bingbing tang. "This repository contains the datasets used for traffic flow analysis and forecasting in Guiyang, China. The data can be used for spatial-temporal modeling, graph neural networks, and intelligent transportation system research. ". Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
